Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the "Analysis of Previous Result" section of its first turn. It incorrectly identified the singer of "You Can Crash My Party Anytime" as Luke Bryan (confusing it with his hit song "Crash My Party") and incorrectly attributed the duet on "Home Alone Tonight" to the entire group "Little Big Town" rather than the specific female vocalist, Karen Fairchild. This initial hallucination led the Planner to formulate a strategy based on false premises and ultimately produce the wrong answer ("Little Big Town") instead of the correct answer ("Karen Fairchild"). Although the WebSurfer agent provided the correct information in its response (stating it is a duet with Karen Fairchild), the Planner ignored this correct data and doubled down on its own incorrect assumptions in the final conclusion.
